title: 11 Best AI App Builders in 2026: Scientifically Tested and Ranked
summary: We scored eleven AI app builders across 7 criteria worth 70 points total. Every score checked against the vendor's own pricing pages, docs, and product pages, and manually tested.
body_markdown: Blink runs $25/mo with production hosting, a custom domain, and a database all included, and that number doesn't change once you're live. Base44 undercuts on sticker price at $16/mo with thinner credits. Anything's $19/mo tier adds a custom domain and private projects, but the free plan can't have either. Rork's real cost depends on which Apple devices you need, from $20/mo up to $200 or more. Cursor and Devin are inexpensive as standalone tools, but neither includes the hosting or backend a shipped product still needs on top.
